title: Verifying Clairaut's Theorem for Mixed Partial Derivatives
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For f(x, y) = x exp(y) + y sin(x), verify that f_{xy} = f_{yx}.

steps.title: Compute First Partials
steps.mathExpression: f_x = e^y + y\cos x, \quad f_y = x e^y + \sin x
steps.explanation: Differentiate with respect to x and y independently.

steps.title: Compute Mixed Second Partials
steps.mathExpression: f_{xy} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(e^y + y\cos x) = e^y + \cos x; \quad f_{yx} = \frac{\partial}{\partial x}(x e^y + \sin x) = e^y + \cos x
steps.explanation: Differentiate f_x with respect to y and f_y with respect to x.
